bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4ebf08dda7073ef199b2b2def8054ed06404842c"
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_integration.py -q >/dev/null
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8081/healthz",timeout=8) as response:
    assert response.status == 200
    value=json.load(response)
assert value.get("service")=="tumblr-operation-app"
assert value.get("commit")=="4ebf08dda7073ef199b2b2def8054ed06404842c"
assert value.get("ui")=="authenticated"
PY
